Description: In 2023, nearly 85 percent of individuals who made online purchases in the last three months bought goods from national sellers in Norway. In comparison, one-third of individuals made cross-border purchases from EU sellers, while around 23 percent of
individuals purchased online from non-EU sellers. Read more
Note(s): Norway; 2023; Individuals who purchased online in the last three months
Source(s): Eurostat

Description: In 2024, the average revenue per user in the e-commerce market in Norway was modeled to amount to 2,070 U.S. dollars. Between 2017 and 2024, the figure dropped by 400 U.S. dollars, though the decline followed an uneven course rather than a steady
trajectory. The forecast shows the average revenue per user will steadily grow by 360 U.S. dollars from 2024 to 2029. Read more
Note(s): Norway; 2017 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights

Description: Norwegian women engaged in e-commerce slightly more than men in 2024. More than nine out of ten women bought or ordered goods online in the last 12 months of the survey. Meanwhile, the survey found that 89 percent of men had done the same.
Additionally, the survey also found that four percent of women and five percent of men have never shopped online. Read more
Note(s): Norway; 2024; 16-79 years
Source(s): Statistics Norway
